name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's own official collection of reusable instruction packs that teach Claude how to do specialized jobs, like following a company's brand guide or a particular research process.
buyer: Not a direct buyer situation — it's a free reference/starter-kit that businesses use as a foundation, not a product anyone pays Anthropic for separately.
business_use_cases: An agency building Claude-based products studies these skills as the reference implementation for writing their own.
A company adapts the document-creation skills to enforce its own brand guidelines automatically in AI-generated content.
A consultant uses it as a teaching example when training a client's team on building Claude skills.

money_ideas.idea: No direct monetization of the repo itself — the opportunity is in building and selling custom skills on top of this foundation for specific industries.

steal_this: Pick one skill here, fork it, and specialize it for a single vertical (e.g. legal contract review) this weekend, then sell it as a paid custom skill.
